title: REST Web Service Integration Guide
subtitle: Investment Account Web Services - PIT Current Version

blocks.html:
This guide describes how to integrate with the Investment Account REST web services. It is intended for software developers who are building applications that consume these services in the Public Interface Testing (PIT) environment and, subsequently, the live environment.

The REST web services accept and return JSON payloads over HTTPS. All requests must be authenticated and signed as described in the Digital Signatures section. Before integrating, developers should review the overview of available endpoints in Calling the Services.

blocks.html: Every request to the REST web services must include a digital signature. The signature proves the identity of the caller and ensures the integrity of the message. Full details of how signatures are constructed are provided in the Digital Signatures section of this guide.

Responses are returned as JSON. Successful responses use standard HTTP 2xx status codes; errors use 4xx and 5xx codes with a structured error body. The following sub-sections describe the responses for each web service.

Validation errors are returned with an HTTP 400 status code. The response body contains a list of errors, each with a code, a target field, and a human-readable message. Clients should surface these messages to the user and allow the request to be corrected and resubmitted.

The handshake web service is used to verify connectivity and authentication before calling any business services. A successful handshake returns an HTTP 200 status code and an acknowledgement payload.

The create account web service returns an HTTP 201 status code on success, along with the identifier of the newly created investment account. Validation failures are returned as described under Validation Errors.
The close account web service returns an HTTP 200 status code on success. If the account cannot be closed (for example, because it has a pending transfer), a business error is returned.
The transfer account web service initiates the transfer of an investment account between providers. It returns an HTTP 202 status code to indicate that the transfer has been accepted for processing.

The eligibility checks web service returns an HTTP 200 status code and an eligibility decision. This service should be called prior to creating an account to confirm the applicant meets the required criteria.
All requests must be signed using HTTP Signatures. This section describes how to build and attach a valid signature to a request.

HTTP Signatures are added to requests using the Signature HTTP header. The signature covers a defined set of request components so that the server can verify both the identity of the caller and that the request has not been tampered with in transit.

Signature: keyId="Test",algorithm="rsa-sha256",
  headers="(request-target) host date digest",
  signature="Base64(RSA-SHA256(signing string))"
The signature is made up of the following components: keyId, algorithm, headers, and signature. The headers component lists, in order, the request fields that are included in the signing string.

The signing string is constructed by concatenating each listed header name and its value, separated by a colon and a space, with each pair on a new line. The order of the headers must match the order declared in the headers component.

Once the signing string has been constructed, it is signed with the caller's private key using the declared algorithm (for example, rsa-sha256). The resulting signature is Base64 encoded and placed in the signature component of the Signature header.
The following example shows a representative request and response for the Create Account web service. Full example message sets are provided separately with the web service examples.

POST /investment-account/v1/accounts HTTP/1.1
Host: softwaretest.ros.ie
Content-Type: application/json
Signature: keyId="Test",algorithm="rsa-sha256",headers="(request-target) host date digest",signature="..."

{
  "applicant": { "ppsn": "1234567T" },
  "product": "INVESTMENT_ACCOUNT"
}
